stopReason: visitor_finished: Simulated dreamcore and liminal-art admirer. The opening portal and tutorials felt very pretty and familiar rather than uncertain or uncanny. On the Garden entrance I tapped the small '夢の見覚え' label and unexpectedly entered a vertically ascending garden; this hidden detour and the solitary petal felt specific, quiet and appealing. I carried the petal into Diary and now stop satisfied after one surprising loop. The regular five-item Garden path, Hotel, Perfume and rest were not tested; this is an artistic reading, not an objective metric.
